recipes.title: Pecan Pie
recipes.note: From Grandma Maude Pauline Herod (DAR)'s handwritten recipe card.
steps: Mix all ingredients for the filling together, adding the pecans last.
Pour into the pastry shell.
Bake in a 400°F (hot) oven for 15 minutes.
Reduce the heat to 350°F (moderate) and bake 30 to 35 minutes longer.
When the pie is done, the outer edge of the filling should be set and the center slightly soft.

recipes.title: Potato Cake
recipes.note: From a handwritten recipe card. The card lists ingredients and an oven temperature only, with no mixing directions or baking time, and the sugar amount is hard to read.
ingredients: Sugar (amount hard to read on the card, looks like 2 cups)
1/2 teaspoon each cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg
steps: Bake at 350 degrees. (The card doesn't give a time.)

recipes.title: Devil Food Cake
recipes.note: From Grandma Maude Pauline Herod (DAR)'s handwritten recipes. The photo cuts off right at "Bake", so the oven temperature and time are still to be added.
steps: Cream the sugar and Crisco. Add the eggs and beat until fluffy.
Sift together the flour, salt and cocoa.
Add the soda with the milk and beat.
Add the vanilla and the boiling water. Beat until smooth.
Pour into five layer pans. Bake (the rest of this line is cut off in the photo).

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup (do not add water or milk)
1 small bag of French fried onions
steps: Spread the green beans into a 9x13 casserole dish.
Melt the cheese with the soup and pour over the green beans.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Spread the French fried onions on top and bake another 5-10 minutes.
To double it, just double the ingredients.

recipes.title: Taco Turnovers
recipes.note: Kids favorite, great with sour cream!
steps: Cook the ground beef.
Fill the croissants with the mixture.
Add shredded cheese on top.
Bake at 375 for 15 minutes.
